clips.title: The story
paras: In Ashenvale, Horde hunters face a new test beneath the ancient trees. Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo sends proven hunters north to Splintertree Post, where Senani Thunderheart awaits.

Horde hunters who have proven themselves in the Barrens are sent toward Ashenvale. Jorn Skyseer sees when a traveler has outgrown the local game and points the way north. For the young Horde, these old forests offer resources and mark a political and spiritual frontier they must learn to understand and claim.

The road north passes the Mor'shan Rampart before reaching Splintertree Post, a fortified Horde camp deep among the trees. The tauren huntress Senani Thunderheart welcomes experienced hunters seeking harder tests of survival. The Horde depends on skilled trackers to face Ashenvale's native predators and the watchful defenders of the forest.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Your strength impresses me, adventurer. Your willingness to embrace the hunt gives me confidence that you could move on to bigger game... And bigger challenges.

The forests of Ashenvale represent a vast untamed wild that the Horde seeks to impose its own will upon, both politically and spiritually. If you seek to prove yourself in an unproven land, seek the guidance of Senani Thunderheart in Splintertree Post. The outpost is due north of the path leading from the Barrens.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Welcome to the new frontier, friend. Ashenvale is a land of opportunity, one where a young adventurer like yourself is able to find boundless chances to prove their mettle. Look around the outpost here, and be sure to travel out to the Zoram Strand, as the Horde has another outpost there as well.
Your presence here tells me that you've come to learn more about the hunt. Listen close, and I will gladly share with you what you need to know.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
